items.name: Title
items.value: Stress test: every feature, nasty data

items.name: Subtitle
items.value: Nulls, empty strings, six scripts, RTL, emoji, 3,400-char notes, words with no spaces, negative and huge numbers, dates in five formats, numbers as strings, a 400-row group, duplicate names. If a section looks wrong, that is the point: fix the engine, not the data.
